notes.title: 🎮 Playtest Now Live! | Secrets of the Burrow: Vixoria’s Quest 🦊
notes.content:
[p][b]🦊 Playtest Now Live – Secrets of the Burrow: Vixoria’s Quest 🎮[/b][/p][p]We’re thrilled to invite you into the world of [b][i]Secrets of the Burrow: Vixoria’s Quest[/i][/b] for our very first [b]playtest[/b]![/p][p]This is an early, in-development slice of the game—[b]not a full demo[/b]—and your feedback during this stage will help shape how the game evolves.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]✅ How to Join:[/h3][p]Click the green [b]\[Request Access][/b] button on our steam page. Once granted, Steam will install the playtest build and you can jump right in![/p][hr][/hr][h3]🔍 What to Expect:[/h3][list][*][p]A portion of the game world, featuring platforming, exploration, and our never before seen combat[/p][/*][*][p]A glimpse of our characters, and visual aesthetic[/p][/*][*][p]Some rough edges—[b]this is an early build[/b], so you may run into bugs, unpolished moments, or missing features[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]📣 We Really Need Your Feedback![/h3][p]This playtest exists so we can listen, learn, and improve—and we mean it! If you play, [b]please take a moment to tell us what worked and what didn’t[/b].[/p][p]👉 [b]Join our official Discord to share feedback directly with the dev team[/b]:
[url="https://discord.gg/5gUm8HTqsX"]https://discord.gg/5gUm8HTqsX[/url][/p][p]You can also post in the [b]Steam Playtest Forum[/b]. Every comment, report, or idea helps more than you know.[/p][hr][/hr][p]Thanks so much for taking the time to help us test and shape [i]Secrets of the Burrow[/i]. We can’t wait to hear what you think![/p][p]🦊 — FOXBOY Productions
The World needs heroes. We just make it fun[/p]
